summary: Retested mobile scroll fix for RecordWorkoutDialog at 390x844 and desktop regression at 1440x900. Fix (max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto) verified working. Log It / Cancel / when-input all reachable via internal scroll on mobile; submit closes the dialog. Desktop unchanged (no scroll needed).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: max-h-[92dvh] uses dvh which accounts for the mobile URL bar/keyboard chrome; overflow-y-auto enables internal scroll. Good choice.
Consider adding sticky footer for Cancel/Log It row so the CTA is always visible without needing user to scroll, but current behavior meets the fix requirement.
